propositions: CLI reconstruction currently uses 19 overlapping frozensets, intercept ladder, and regex-based reference generation with 54 hand-maintained help resources, creating parser/help drift risk
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help and report as unknown to `rebar help <command>` while handler `--help` is inconsistent and can execute work
Runtime and build-time command parsing must derive from a single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory to eliminate manual syntax authority
Generated package-help and overview bytes must remain authoritative at runtime before operation/config/mount, ensuring help/unknown paths never compose operations
Exact command aliases, hidden commands (bridge-status), compatibility spellings (jira-onboard), and unknown commands (purge-bridge) must exhibit approved behavior without operation effects
Optional semantic capabilities must register without eager optional imports; checks occur after mode/backend selection
